name: Cinel AI
tagline: Free-start AI image and video generator with a prompt library.
description: Start with a free image and turn the best frame into video. Cinel AI combines GPT Image 2.6 and Nano Banana 2.1 for stills with Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.5 for motion. It needs no login and includes a prompt library at cinel.ai/prompts.
